feeds.title: Tom Livingstone Climbing
feeds.description: A Climbing Blog by Tom Livingstone - a climber and writer, based in North Wales (UK). He enjoys alpine, trad, and winter climbing in the mountains. He is an acclaimed outdoor writer, and you can read some of his published pieces here.

feeds.title: Climber
feeds.description: Dedicated to all aspects of rock climbing and mountaineering; trad climbing, sport climbing, bouldering, alpine climbing, winter, and ice climbing and expeditions. Climber magazine includes guides and features to climbing and bouldering at UK crags, travel and adventure destinations from around the world, interviews, and profiles of top climbers and mountaineers, breathtaking photography, training and coaching features every month from Gareth Parry, advice and information on skills, technique, and safety, reviews and advice on essential climbing gear and equipment.
